contract_history: The initial display criteria draft predated the first successful development tile build but was not committed then. The zoom range, explicit scale factor, no-drop setting and z10 source-row coverage remain the pre-conversion acceptance criteria. The Hausdorff sample was added after development output existed and is explicitly a follow-up diagnostic, not preregistered acceptance.

events.diagnostic: Producer ID nulls/duplicates prevent stable tile IDs
events.correction: Keep producer ID as an attribute; use unique one-based source_row as the tile ID.
events.attempt_output_path: .local/grwl/dev/build-one (this path was created only on a later corrected attempt; the uniqueness-check failure occurred before the build directory was created)

events.diagnostic: Arrow rejected rescaling Decimal value without data loss: width_sd_m at source row 23108 has 12 decimal places despite declared DBF scale 11; Shape_Leng includes 13-place scientific-notation values.
events.correction: Choose a per-field Arrow Decimal scale equal to the maximum of declared scale and observed source value scale; compare every value to DBF.
events.attempt_output_path: no output directory was created before decimal conversion failed

events.diagnostic: Validator assumed GeoParquet CRS authority/code at a JSON path incompatible with pyproj PROJJSON output.
events.correction: Check EPSG authority and code from actual metadata.

events.diagnostic: NameError: name tool_lock is not defined while constructing manifest. No manifest or release report was produced.
events.correction: Define and enforce the Tippecanoe version and binary hash before conversion.

events.diagnostic: Validator could not load remote STAC 1.1 and extension JSON schemas in the restricted environment; this was not treated as a schema pass.
SHP header bbox xmax is 180.00000000010002, while feature vertices stay in-range (feature-coordinate xmax is below 180). The analytic coordinates were unchanged; display longitude clamp is a no-op.

development_success_note: The ignored build-one prototype passed a draft analytic parity, z10 ID coverage and loopback range/CORS check before later code changes. It is not a release artifact or a validation receipt for the final code.
final_gate_plan: Run both the Node validator and bundled-schema Rashid gate in the committed clean-checkout rehearsal; preserve each actual result separately.
